title: Implement direct YAML LLM invocation and CLI execution
objective: Deliver a minimal, locally runnable langgraph-exec release that executes one parameterized LLM node from YAML through the existing llm package boundary.

branch.name: wi-0001-phase-one-direct-llm
branch.rationale: The branch isolates WI-0001 implementation and release work.

request.text: Create WI-0001 for langgraph-exec: Deliver a minimal, locally runnable langgraph-exec release that executes one parameterized LLM node from YAML through the existing llm package boundary.

scope.name: direct-node-contract
scope.description: Define the phase-one YAML node artifact for one parameterized known node type, initially llm.complete.
scope.reason: The first release needs one bounded component contract before graph composition exists.

scope.name: llm-adapter
scope.description: Build the injected adapter over /home/michael/src/github/llm for request construction, response handling, and bounded errors.
scope.reason: Provider and structured-output behavior must remain owned by the llm package.

scope.name: cli-commands
scope.description: Implement provider-free validate and inspect commands plus explicit run behavior for direct YAML LLM invocation.
scope.reason: The capability must be usable through a thin installed CLI.

scope.name: unit-tests
scope.description: Add deterministic unit tests for YAML parsing, parameter binding, request mapping, response mapping, and CLI boundaries.
scope.reason: The phase must be releasable without live provider tests.

scope.name: local-release
scope.description: Build, typecheck, test, link through the user-local npm prefix, and verify the installed langgraph-exec command.
scope.reason: Every phase must produce local CLI delivery evidence.

nonGoals.name: graphs
nonGoals.description: Do not implement graph topology, imports, nested components, or graph execution.

nonGoals.name: loops
nonGoals.description: Do not implement cycles, retries as graph edges, or bounded loops.

nonGoals.name: compatibility
nonGoals.description: Do not require phase-one node YAML to remain compatible with later node contracts.
nonGoals.reason: Later phases may revise or replace the node contract through explicit schema/version migration.

nonGoals.name: live-providers
nonGoals.description: Do not make authenticated or live provider calls a release gate.
nonGoals.reason: Deterministic fake LLM services provide the unit evidence boundary.

items.name: direct-node-yaml
items.description: A closed versioned YAML node definition can declare parameters, ports, and a registered llm.complete implementation.
items.reason: A direct component contract is the minimum useful execution unit.

acceptanceCriteria.description: A valid node parses and exposes its declared implementation, parameters, and ports without graph topology.

items.name: llm-boundary
items.description: The node resolves a final llm/request/v1 request and delegates to the injected /home/michael/src/github/llm service.
items.reason: The graph project must not duplicate provider transport or response validation.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Fake-service tests capture the final request and return a closed response envelope without network activity.

items.name: cli-surface
items.description: The CLI provides validate, inspect, and run command boundaries with stable nonzero behavior for invalid input and bounded provider errors.
items.reason: Users need an executable workflow entrypoint rather than a library-only contract.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The linked command responds to --help and --version and runs provider-free validation/inspection.

items.name: phase-one-tests
items.description: The phase has deterministic unit tests covering valid and invalid YAML, parameter defaults/overrides, mappings, and CLI behavior.
items.reason: Later phases must not be the first place direct execution is verified.

acceptanceCriteria.description: yarn test passes the phase-one suite with no live provider dependency.

items.name: phase-one-link
items.description: The package is buildable and registered with npm --prefix "$HOME/.local" link.
items.reason: The requested release process is part of the phase boundary.

acceptanceCriteria.description: command -v langgraph-exec and langgraph-exec --help resolve the checked-out package.
